name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
Ultra-fast live-stream clip trimming: downloads only the exact 8-15 segments needed for your clip instead of multi-hour streams.
Fixed Instagram photo carousels & multi-slide posts (extracts all high-res photos and videos).
Optimized stream downloading with expanded probe window and fast keyframe extraction.
Fixed Instagram Reel and video direct high-definition streams.
Universal video validation: safely accepts all valid progressive MP4, WebM, and TS formats.
Bulletproof download engine with automatic Range-based connection resume and retry.
